tool_input.description: Get repo size excluding build artifacts

result:
This is Zed, the code editor — a large Rust **workspace** (not a single crate).

**Scale**
- 236 workspace member crates under `crates/` (~73M of source)
- 3,754 source files, ~54,554 symbols, 330 modules (per carto's index)
- 82,911 call edges, 4,789 import edges tracked — this is a big, densely-interconnected codebase

**Main architectural pieces** (by import fan-out, i.e. the modules that pull in the most other code — a good proxy for "central orchestrator"):

| Crate | Root file | Role |
|---|---|---|
| `gpui` | `crates/gpui/src/gpui.rs` | The custom UI/app framework underlying everything (entities, contexts, elements, rendering, concurrency) |
| `editor` | `crates/editor/src/editor.rs` | The core text editor component — highest fan-out in the repo |
| `workspace` | `crates/workspace/src/workspace.rs` | Window/pane/dock management, ties editor+project+UI together |
| `project` | `crates/project/src/project.rs` | Project model — files, buffers, LSP, worktrees |
| `agent_ui` | `crates/agent_ui/src/agent_ui.rs` | AI agent panel/UI |
| `git_ui` | `crates/git_ui/src/git_ui.rs` | Git integration UI |
| `edit_prediction` | `crates/edit_prediction/src/edit_prediction.rs` | Inline edit-prediction feature |
| `util` | `crates/util/src/util.rs` | Shared utility helpers |

Top external dependencies by usage: `std`, `collections` (in-house), `gpui` itself (270 internal importers), `anyhow`, `serde_json`, `futures`, `parking_lot`, `indoc`, `itertools`, `smallvec` — consistent with an async, entity-based GUI app built on custom primitives rather than a typical web/Electron stack.

Layered picture: `gpui` (framework) → `project`/`editor`/`workspace` (core app model + UI) → feature crates (`git_ui`, `agent_ui`, `edit_prediction`, and many more) plugging into `workspace` as panels/docks, with `util`/`collections` as shared low-level support.
